{"plan":{"grain":"每行一个已完成订单（order_id）。","sources":["fact_orders","dim_customers"],"joins":["fact_orders.customer_id = dim_customers.customer_id（多对一）。"],"filters":["fact_orders.status = 'completed'。","fact_orders.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'。"],"metrics":["直接输出订单头 total_amount，不做聚合。"],"steps":["筛选 2026-01-01 起的已完成订单。","连接客户维表取得 customer_name。","输出指定字段并按 total_amount 降序、order_id 升序。"],"risks":["customer_id 外键或客户维度唯一性异常可能导致订单缺失或重复。","total_amount 采用订单头值，未核验其与订单行净额汇总的一致性。"]},"sql":"SELECT
    o.order_id,
    c.customer_name,
    o.order_date,
    o.total_amount
FROM fact_orders AS o
JOIN dim_customers AS c
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
ORDER BY o.total_amount DESC, o.order_id ASC","summary":"筛选 2026-01-01 起的已完成订单，连接客户维表获取客户名称，输出订单字段并按金额降序、订单号升序排列。","assumptions":[]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每行一个商品品类 category","sources":["fact_orders","fact_order_items","dim_products"],"joins":["fact_order_items.order_id = fact_orders.order_id","fact_order_items.product_id = dim_products.product_id"],"filters":["fact_orders.status = 'completed'"],"metrics":["order_count = COUNT(DISTINCT fact_orders.order_id)","net_revenue = SUM(quantity * unit_price - discount_amount)"],"steps":["连接订单、订单行和商品三表","筛选已完成订单","按 category 分组计算指标","按 net_revenue 降序、category 升序排序"],"risks":["同一订单跨品类时会分别计入各品类的 distinct 订单数","使用 DECIMAL 行金额求和以保持金额精度"]},"sql":"SELECT
    p.category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS net_revenue
FROM fact_orders AS o
JOIN fact_order_items AS oi
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN dim_products AS p
    ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, p.category ASC","summary":"连接订单、订单行和商品表，筛选已完成订单后按品类统计 distinct 订单数与订单行净销售额，并按指定顺序排序。","assumptions":[]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每行一个客户。","sources":["dim_customers","fact_orders"],"joins":["dim_customers LEFT JOIN fact_orders ON fact_orders.customer_id = dim_customers.customer_id，保留零订单客户。"],"filters":["仅在聚合条件中计入 fact_orders.status = 'completed'，不使用 WHERE 过滤右表。"],"metrics":["completed_order_count = COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fact_orders.status = 'completed' THEN fact_orders.order_id END)。"],"steps":["以 dim_customers 为主表左连接 fact_orders。","按 customer_id、customer_name 分组并计算已完成订单数。","按 completed_order_count 降序、customer_id 升序排序。"],"risks":["若将完成状态条件放入 WHERE，会丢失零订单客户。","连接订单表后必须按客户聚合，避免输出重复客户。"]},"sql":"SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN o.status = 'completed' THEN o.order_id
    END) AS completed_order_count
FROM dim_customers AS c
LEFT JOIN fact_orders AS o
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name
ORDER BY
    completed_order_count DESC,
    c.customer_id ASC;","summary":"以客户表为主表 LEFT JOIN 订单表，通过条件去重计数统计已完成订单，保留零订单客户并按指定顺序排序。","assumptions":[]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每行一个高于所属客户分群均值的已完成订单。","sources":["fact_orders：订单状态、金额与客户键。","dim_customers：客户分群。"],"joins":["fact_orders.customer_id = dim_customers.customer_id。","相关子查询内以客户键连接订单与客户，并用内层 segment = 外层 segment 关联。"],"filters":["外层订单 status = 'completed'。","相关子查询均值仅包含 status = 'completed' 的订单。","total_amount > segment_avg_amount。"],"metrics":["segment_avg_amount = 同客户分群已完成订单的 AVG(total_amount)。"],"steps":["连接已完成订单与客户，取得 segment。","用引用外层 segment 的相关标量子查询计算分群平均订单金额。","筛选订单金额严格高于分群均值的记录。","按 total_amount 降序、order_id 升序排序。"],"risks":["按 segment 标签分组；同名分群会被视为同一分群。","严格大于均值，等于均值的订单不输出。"]},"sql":"SELECT
    ranked_orders.order_id,
    ranked_orders.customer_id,
    ranked_orders.segment,
    ranked_orders.total_amount,
    ranked_orders.segment_avg_amount
FROM (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        c.segment,
        o.total_amount,
        (
            SELECT AVG(o2.total_amount)
            FROM fact_orders AS o2
            JOIN dim_customers AS c2
              ON o2.customer_id = c2.customer_id
            WHERE o2.status = 'completed'
              AND c2.segment = c.segment
        ) AS segment_avg_amount
    FROM fact_orders AS o
    JOIN dim_customers AS c
      ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
) AS ranked_orders
WHERE ranked_orders.total_amount > ranked_orders.segment_avg_amount
ORDER BY ranked_orders.total_amount DESC, ranked_orders.order_id ASC","summary":"连接已完成订单与客户，并通过引用外层客户分群的相关子查询计算该分群已完成订单平均金额，再筛选高于均值的订单并按要求排序。","assumptions":[]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每行一个从未有已完成订单的客户","sources":["dim_customers","fact_orders"],"joins":["相关子查询按 fact_orders.customer_id = dim_customers.customer_id 匹配"],"filters":["NOT EXISTS 匹配客户且 fact_orders.status = 'completed' 的订单"],"metrics":[],"steps":["扫描客户主表","用 NOT EXISTS 排除存在已完成订单的客户","输出客户标识和名称","按 customer_id 升序排序"],"risks":["必须将 completed 状态条件置于 NOT EXISTS 子查询内","避免普通连接造成客户重复"]},"sql":"SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name
FROM dim_customers AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM fact_orders AS o
    WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id
      AND o.status = 'completed'
)
ORDER BY c.customer_id ASC;","summary":"从客户主表出发，使用相关 NOT EXISTS 子查询排除任何存在已完成订单的客户，并按 customer_id 升序输出。","assumptions":[]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每行一个品类内排名前三的商品。","sources":["fact_orders","fact_order_items","dim_products"],"joins":["fact_order_items.order_id = fact_orders.order_id","fact_order_items.product_id = dim_products.product_id"],"filters":["fact_orders.status = 'completed'","ROW_NUMBER 排名后 rank_no <= 3"],"metrics":["net_revenue = SUM(quantity * unit_price - discount_amount)","rank_no = ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, product_id ASC)"],"steps":["按 category、product_id、product_name 汇总完成订单行净销售额。","使用 ROW_NUMBER 按品类分区，以净销售额降序、product_id 升序编号。","保留每个品类 rank_no 1 至 3，并按 category、rank_no 升序输出。"],"risks":["只有完成订单中的商品参与排名。","同额仅以 product_id 升序确定唯一顺序。","品类不足三个商品时无法输出恰好三行。"]},"sql":"WITH product_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        p.product_id,
        p.product_name,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS net_revenue
    FROM fact_order_items AS oi
    INNER JOIN fact_orders AS o
        ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    INNER JOIN dim_products AS p
        ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY
        p.category,
        p.product_id,
        p.product_name
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        product_id,
        product_name,
        net_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, product_id ASC
        ) AS rank_no
    FROM product_revenue
)
SELECT
    category,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    net_revenue,
    rank_no
FROM ranked_products
WHERE rank_no <= 3
ORDER BY category ASC, rank_no ASC","summary":"先汇总完成订单中各品类商品的净销售额，再用 ROW_NUMBER 按品类分区排名并取前三。","assumptions":[]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每个有已完成订单商品行的 2025 年月份一行。","sources":["fact_orders","fact_order_items"],"joins":["fact_order_items.order_id = fact_orders.order_id（多对一连接订单头）"],"filters":["fact_orders.status = 'completed'","fact_orders.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND fact_orders.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'"],"metrics":["monthly_revenue = SUM(quantity * unit_price - discount_amount)","cumulative_revenue = SUM(monthly_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)"],"steps":["连接订单头与订单行。","按 UTC Gregorian 月份聚合已完成订单行净销售额。","按 month 排序执行 SUM 窗口计算累计收入。","按 month 升序输出。"],"risks":["无日历表，因此没有已完成订单商品行的月份不会生成零值行。","订单行重复或缺失会影响收入汇总。"]},"sql":"WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT
        strftime(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS monthly_revenue
    FROM fact_orders AS o
    INNER JOIN fact_order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY strftime(o.order_date, '%Y-%m')
)
SELECT
    month,
    monthly_revenue,
    SUM(monthly_revenue) OVER (
        ORDER BY month
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_revenue
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month ASC","summary":"按 2025 年月份汇总已完成订单商品行净销售额，并使用按 month 排序的 SUM 窗口计算累计收入。","assumptions":["结果仅包含至少存在一条已完成订单商品行的月份，不补齐无数据月份。"]}

{"plan":{"grain":"2025 年每个日历月一行，共 12 行。","sources":["fact_orders","fact_order_items","DuckDB range(12) 生成 2025 月历"],"joins":["fact_order_items.order_id = fact_orders.order_id","月历 LEFT JOIN 月度收入，保留无收入月份"],"filters":["fact_orders.status = 'completed'","fact_orders.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND fact_orders.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'"],"metrics":["monthly_revenue = SUM(quantity * unit_price - discount_amount)，无收入月为 0","mom_pct = (本月收入 - LAG(本月收入)) / LAG(本月收入) * 100，四舍五入 2 位"],"steps":["生成 2025 年 12 个月月历","按订单月份汇总完成订单行净销售额","补齐无收入月份并使用 LAG 取得上月收入","计算环比百分比并按 month 升序输出"],"risks":["避免订单头 total_amount 替代订单行净销售额","上月收入为 0 时环比无法定义，返回 NULL","先按月聚合再计算 LAG，避免明细粒度导致重复"]},"sql":"WITH calendar_months AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' + i * INTERVAL '1 month' AS month_start
    FROM range(12) AS r(i)
),
monthly_aggregates AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('month', o.order_date)::DATE AS month_start,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS monthly_revenue
    FROM fact_orders AS o
    INNER JOIN fact_order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY 1
),
monthly_series AS (
    SELECT
        c.month_start,
        COALESCE(m.monthly_revenue, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38, 2))) AS monthly_revenue
    FROM calendar_months AS c
    LEFT JOIN monthly_aggregates AS m
        ON m.month_start = c.month_start
),
with_previous AS (
    SELECT
        month_start,
        monthly_revenue,
        LAG(monthly_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS previous_month_revenue
    FROM monthly_series
)
SELECT
    strftime(month_start, '%Y-%m') AS month,
    monthly_revenue,
    CASE
        WHEN previous_month_revenue IS NULL OR previous_month_revenue = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(
            (monthly_revenue - previous_month_revenue) * 100.0
            / previous_month_revenue,
            2
        )
    END AS mom_pct
FROM with_previous
ORDER BY month_start ASC;","summary":"按完成订单的订单行净额汇总 2025 年月收入，补齐 12 个日历月，并用 LAG 计算相邻月份的收入环比。","assumptions":["“2025 年每月”要求输出 2025 年全部 12 个月，无完成订单的月份收入记为 0。","上月收入为 0 时环比百分比在数学上无法定义，因此返回 NULL。"]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每行一个高于基准的客户。","sources":["fact_orders","fact_order_items","dim_customers"],"joins":["fact_orders.customer_id = dim_customers.customer_id","fact_order_items.order_id = fact_orders.order_id（LEFT JOIN）"],"filters":["fact_orders.status = 'completed'","total_spend > 有已完成订单客户的平均 total_spend"],"metrics":["total_spend = SUM(quantity * unit_price - discount_amount)","平均累计消费 = AVG(customer-level total_spend)"],"steps":["按客户汇总全部已完成订单行净销售额。","在客户汇总结果上计算全体客户平均累计消费。","筛选累计消费高于平均值的客户。","按 total_spend 降序、customer_id 升序排序。"],"risks":["先按客户聚合再计算平均，避免订单行数造成客户加权。","LEFT JOIN 保留存在已完成订单但缺少订单行的客户，并将其消费计为 0。","仅使用已完成订单，且净销售额严格扣除 discount_amount。"]},"sql":"SELECT
    customer_id,
    customer_name,
    total_spend
FROM (
    SELECT
        customer_spend.customer_id,
        customer_spend.customer_name,
        customer_spend.total_spend,
        AVG(customer_spend.total_spend) OVER () AS avg_total_spend
    FROM (
        SELECT
            c.customer_id,
            c.customer_name,
            SUM(
                COALESCE(
                    oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount,
                    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(14, 2))
                )
            ) AS total_spend
        FROM fact_orders AS o
        INNER JOIN dim_customers AS c
            ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
        LEFT JOIN fact_order_items AS oi
            ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
        WHERE o.status = 'completed'
        GROUP BY
            c.customer_id,
            c.customer_name
    ) AS customer_spend
) AS customer_spend_with_average
WHERE total_spend > avg_total_spend
ORDER BY
    total_spend DESC,
    customer_id ASC","summary":"先汇总每位有已完成订单客户的订单行净销售额，再通过外层派生表计算客户平均累计消费，筛出高于平均值者并按指定顺序输出。","assumptions":[]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每行一个渠道类型（channel_type）","sources":["dim_channels","fact_orders","fact_payments"],"joins":["fact_payments.order_id = fact_orders.order_id","fact_orders.channel_id = dim_channels.channel_id"],"filters":[],"metrics":["paid_amount = SUM(CASE WHEN fact_payments.status = 'paid' THEN fact_payments.amount ELSE 0 END)","refunded_amount = SUM(CASE WHEN fact_payments.status = 'refunded' THEN fact_payments.amount ELSE 0 END)","failed_amount = SUM(CASE WHEN fact_payments.status = 'failed' THEN fact_payments.amount ELSE 0 END)"],"steps":["连接支付、订单和渠道表","按 channel_type 分组并执行三组条件聚合","按 channel_type 升序排序"],"risks":["一个订单可有多笔支付；按支付尝试粒度汇总金额，符合指标口径","仅有支付记录关联到的渠道类型会出现在结果中"]},"sql":"SELECT
    c.channel_type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'paid' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS paid_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'refunded' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS refunded_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'failed' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS failed_amount
FROM fact_payments AS p
JOIN fact_orders AS o
    ON p.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN dim_channels AS c
    ON o.channel_id = c.channel_id
GROUP BY c.channel_type
ORDER BY c.channel_type ASC","summary":"将支付记录经订单关联到渠道，按渠道类型分组，并使用三组 SUM(CASE WHEN ...) 分别汇总 paid、refunded 和 failed 状态金额。","assumptions":[]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每行一个已完成订单商品品类。","sources":["fact_orders","fact_order_items","fact_returns","dim_products"],"joins":["售出聚合：fact_orders 按 order_id 连接 fact_order_items，再按 product_id 连接 dim_products。","退货聚合：fact_returns 按 (order_id, line_no) 连接 fact_order_items，再连接 fact_orders 和 dim_products。","最终以售出品类为主表，按 category 左连接退货聚合。"],"filters":["售出数量仅包含 fact_orders.status = 'completed'。","退货数量仅包含 fact_orders.status = 'completed' 对应订单行。"],"metrics":["sold_qty = SUM(fact_order_items.quantity)。","returned_qty = SUM(fact_returns.return_qty)，无退货填 0。","return_rate = ROUND(returned_qty / sold_qty, 4)。"],"steps":["在 sold_by_category CTE 按品类聚合已完成订单售出数量。","在 returned_by_category CTE 按品类独立聚合已完成订单退货数量。","连接两个品类级聚合并计算退货率。","按 return_rate 降序、category 升序排序。"],"risks":["售出与退货必须先独立聚合，避免多条退货记录放大售出数量。","使用 NULLIF 防止 sold_qty 为 0 时除零。","退货品类依赖订单行商品当前映射。"]},"sql":"WITH sold_by_category AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold_qty
    FROM fact_orders AS o
    INNER JOIN fact_order_items AS oi
        ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    INNER JOIN dim_products AS p
        ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY p.category
),
returned_by_category AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        SUM(r.return_qty) AS returned_qty
    FROM fact_returns AS r
    INNER JOIN fact_order_items AS oi
        ON r.order_id = oi.order_id
       AND r.line_no = oi.line_no
    INNER JOIN fact_orders AS o
        ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    INNER JOIN dim_products AS p
        ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT
    s.category,
    s.sold_qty,
    COALESCE(r.returned_qty, 0) AS returned_qty,
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(r.returned_qty, 0)::DECIMAL(38, 10)
        / NULLIF(s.sold_qty, 0),
        4
    ) AS return_rate
FROM sold_by_category AS s
LEFT JOIN returned_by_category AS r
    ON s.category = r.category
ORDER BY return_rate DESC, s.category ASC","summary":"分别在品类粒度聚合已完成订单的售出数量与退货数量，再连接聚合结果计算四舍五入至 4 位的退货率，避免明细连接导致 fan-out。","assumptions":[]}

payload.grain: 每行一个已完成订单商品品类。

{"plan":{"grain":"每个有成功支付的订单一行，保留最新一笔成功支付","sources":["fact_payments"],"joins":[],"filters":["fact_payments.status = 'paid'","ROW_NUMBER 排名 = 1"],"metrics":[],"steps":["筛选成功支付记录","按 order_id 分区，paid_at 降序、payment_id 降序计算 ROW_NUMBER","保留每个订单排名第一的记录","按 order_id 升序输出指定字段"],"risks":["同一 paid_at 的记录必须用 payment_id 降序确定唯一最新记录"]},"sql":"SELECT
    order_id,
    payment_id,
    paid_at,
    amount
FROM (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        payment_id,
        paid_at,
        amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_id
            ORDER BY paid_at DESC, payment_id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM fact_payments
    WHERE status = 'paid'
) AS ranked_payments
WHERE rn = 1

{"plan":{"grain":"每行一个渠道。","sources":["dim_channels","fact_orders","fact_order_items"],"joins":["fact_orders LEFT JOIN fact_order_items ON fact_order_items.order_id = fact_orders.order_id","dim_channels LEFT JOIN 完成订单渠道汇总 ON channel_id"],"filters":["仅在渠道汇总中筛选 fact_orders.status = 'completed'。"],"metrics":["completed_order_count：完成订单去重计数。","net_revenue：完成订单行的 quantity * unit_price - discount_amount 之和。"],"steps":["按 channel_id 汇总完成订单数和订单行净销售额。","从 dim_channels 左连接渠道汇总以保留所有渠道。","将缺失指标置为 0，并按 channel_id 升序。"],"risks":["订单与订单行连接会复制订单头，订单数须使用 COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)。","过滤条件必须位于汇总子查询内，避免排除无完成订单的渠道。"],"sql":"WITH completed_by_channel AS (
    SELECT
        o.channel_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS completed_order_count,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS net_revenue
    FROM fact_orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN fact_order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY o.channel_id
)
SELECT
    c.channel_id,
    c.channel_name,
    COALESCE(a.completed_order_count, 0) AS completed_order_count,
    COALESCE(a.net_revenue, 0) AS net_revenue
FROM dim_channels AS c
LEFT JOIN completed_by_channel AS a
    ON a.channel_id = c.channel_id
ORDER BY c.channel_id ASC","summary":"先按渠道汇总完成订单去重数及订单行净销售额，再左连接渠道维表保留全部渠道，缺失指标补 0。","assumptions":[]}}

{"plan":{"grain":"每行一个 channel_type。","sources":["dim_channels","fact_orders","fact_order_items","fact_payments"],"joins":["fact_orders.channel_id = dim_channels.channel_id","fact_order_items.order_id = fact_orders.order_id","fact_payments.order_id = fact_orders.order_id","各指标子查询按 channel_type 聚合后连接。"],"filters":["completed_order_count 与 net_revenue 仅包含 fact_orders.status = 'completed'。","支付金额仅按 fact_payments.status 分为 paid、refunded、failed。"],"metrics":["completed_order_count：完成订单去重计数。","net_revenue：完成订单行的 quantity * unit_price - discount_amount 之和。","paid_amount：status = 'paid' 的支付金额之和。","refunded_amount：status = 'refunded' 的支付金额之和。","failed_amount：status = 'failed' 的支付金额之和。"],"steps":["生成唯一 channel_type 集合。","分别聚合完成订单数、净销售额和各状态支付金额。","将聚合结果连接到 channel_type 集合并将缺失指标补零。","按 channel_type 升序输出。"],"risks":["订单行与支付记录不得直接连接，以免形成多对多重复计算。","同一 channel_type 可对应多个 channel_id，必须先按 channel_type 汇总。"]},"sql":"WITH channel_types AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT channel_type
    FROM dim_channels
),
completed_orders AS (
    SELECT
        c.channel_type,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS completed_order_count
    FROM fact_orders AS o
    INNER JOIN dim_channels AS c
        ON o.channel_id = c.channel_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY c.channel_type
),
net_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        c.channel_type,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS net_revenue
    FROM fact_order_items AS oi
    INNER JOIN fact_orders AS o
        ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    INNER JOIN dim_channels AS c
        ON o.channel_id = c.channel_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY c.channel_type
),
payment_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        c.channel_type,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'paid' THEN p.amount ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(14,2)) END) AS paid_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'refunded' THEN p.amount ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(14,2)) END) AS refunded_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'failed' THEN p.amount ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(14,2)) END) AS failed_amount
    FROM fact_payments AS p
    INNER JOIN fact_orders AS o
        ON p.order_id = o.order_id
    INNER JOIN dim_channels AS c
        ON o.channel_id = c.channel_id
    GROUP BY c.channel_type
)
SELECT
    ct.channel_type,
    COALESCE(co.completed_order_count, 0) AS completed_order_count,
    COALESCE(nr.net_revenue, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(14,2))) AS net_revenue,
    COALESCE(pa.paid_amount, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(14,2))) AS paid_amount,
    COALESCE(pa.refunded_amount, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(14,2))) AS refunded_amount,
    COALESCE(pa.failed_amount, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(14,2))) AS failed_amount
FROM channel_types AS ct
LEFT JOIN completed_orders AS co
    ON ct.channel_type = co.channel_type
LEFT JOIN net_revenue AS nr
    ON ct.channel_type = nr.channel_type
LEFT JOIN payment_amounts AS pa
    ON ct.channel_type = pa.channel_type
ORDER BY ct.channel_type ASC","summary":"按 channel_type 分别预聚合完成订单、完成订单行净销售额和支付状态金额，再连接各聚合结果，避免订单行与支付记录直接连接导致重复计算。","assumptions":[]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每行一个商品品类 category。","sources":["fact_orders：订单状态。","fact_order_items：订单行数量、单价和折扣。","dim_products：商品品类。"],"joins":["fact_order_items.order_id = fact_orders.order_id。","fact_order_items.product_id = dim_products.product_id。"],"filters":["fact_orders.status = 'completed'。"],"metrics":["net_revenue = SUM(quantity * unit_price - discount_amount)。","revenue_share_pct = ROUND(net_revenue / 全部品类 net_revenue * 100, 2)。"],"steps":["连接完成订单、订单行和商品。","按 category 汇总净销售额。","用窗口汇总全部品类净销售额并计算占比。","按 revenue_share_pct 降序、category 升序排序。"],"risks":["全部品类净销售额为 0 时，占比返回 NULL。","仅有完成订单行的品类会出现在结果中。"]},"sql":"WITH category_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS net_revenue
    FROM fact_orders AS o
    INNER JOIN fact_order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    INNER JOIN dim_products AS p
        ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY p.category
), category_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        net_revenue,
        ROUND(
            100.0 * net_revenue / NULLIF(SUM(net_revenue) OVER (), 0),
            2
        ) AS revenue_share_pct
    FROM category_revenue
)
SELECT
    category,
    net_revenue,
    revenue_share_pct
FROM category_metrics
ORDER BY revenue_share_pct DESC NULLS LAST, category ASC;","summary":"按商品品类汇总完成订单行的净销售额，再以全部品类净销售额为分母计算百分比占比并四舍五入至 2 位，最后按指定顺序排序。","assumptions":[]}

{"plan":{"grain":"每行一个存在金额差异的订单。","sources":["fact_orders：订单头存储金额。","fact_order_items：订单行数量、单价和折扣。"],"joins":["按 fact_orders.order_id = fact_order_items.order_id 左连接，保留无订单行的订单。"],"filters":["仅保留 stored_total 与 calculated_total 不相等的订单。"],"metrics":["stored_total = ROUND(fact_orders.total_amount, 2)。","calculated_total = ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price - discount_amount), 2)，无订单行按 0 处理。","difference = ROUND(stored_total - calculated_total, 2)。"],"steps":["按 order_id 汇总订单行净额。","计算并四舍五入存储金额、行汇总金额及差额。","筛选差异订单，并按绝对差异降序、order_id 升序排序。"],"risks":["无订单行的订单将以 calculated_total = 0 参与对账。","差异判断基于四舍五入到 2 位后的金额。"]},"sql":"WITH reconciliation AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        ROUND(o.total_amount, 2) AS stored_total,
        ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount), 0), 2) AS calculated_total
    FROM fact_orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN fact_order_items AS oi
        ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id, o.total_amount
), differences AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        stored_total,
        calculated_total,
        ROUND(stored_total - calculated_total, 2) AS difference
    FROM reconciliation
    WHERE stored_total <> calculated_total
)
SELECT
    order_id,
    stored_total,
    calculated_total,
    difference
FROM differences
ORDER BY ABS(difference) DESC, order_id ASC","summary":"汇总每个订单的订单行净额，与订单头 total_amount 在 2 位小数精度下对账，仅输出有差异的订单并按指定顺序排列。","assumptions":[]}
